import json, time
from harness import *
fails=[]
D=4294967295
def T(name, policy, want, services=None, extra=None):
    svcs=services or [{'name':'A','label':1},{'name':'B','label':2},{'name':'C','label':3},{'name':'D','label':4}]
    events=[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':policy}]
    if extra: events+=extra
    got=ev(job(svcs,events))
    if want=='OK':
        ok = isinstance(got,list) and got[0].get('ok') is True
    elif want=='REJ':
        ok = isinstance(got,list) and got[0]=={'error':'rejected'}
    else:
        ok = isinstance(got,list) and got[0].get('image')==want
    if not ok:
        print('FAIL',name,'->',json.dumps(got[0])[:300] if isinstance(got,list) else got)
        fails.append(name)
    else: print('ok  ',name)
